paper_metadata.title: Micromechanical origin for the wide range of strength-ductility trade-off in metastable high entropy alloys

evidence.quote: Micromechanical origin for the wide range of strength-ductility trade-off in metastable high entropy alloys

the continuous deformation mechanisms of interstitial metastable HEAs with different tensile properties are revealed in a complete picture via real-time in-situ neutron diffraction, EBSD, and ECCI analyses.
